notes.note: Delta-only re-review of EventStore usage facts and read-statement types: selected tool JSON is projected by removing output/attachment bodies from its own payload, preserving malformed-JSON and null failures rather than manufacturing a tool count. The shared usage fold, authorization, cursor and write contracts are unchanged. Removed six unnecessary read casts and only two obsolete baseline rows; the type-laundering gate passes. Real-service regressions cover corrupted selected rows and normal usage. Existing document claims remain accurate; no provider, browser or production qualification is added.
